structuredContent.title: Looking after your prompts and tools > Say that AI helped
structuredContent.text:
Looking after your prompts and tools > Say that AI helped

A document that AI helped to produce says so inside the document, beside its owner, version and review date. One sentence does it.

Parts of this document were drafted with AI support ([tool or skill], version [x]) from the sources listed. [Name] reviewed it on [date].
